item.title: Epstein victim's brother hopes ex-Prince Andrew's arrest signals 'house of cards' collapsing
item.description: Sky Roberts, whose sister Virginia Roberts Giuffre took her own life in Australia last year, and his wife urges US Justice Department to take action against others playing role in paedophile Epstein's crimes.

item.title: Death toll from Israel's genocide in Gaza higher than reported in first 15 months, says Lancet
item.description: Researchers estimate that women, children, elderly made up 56 % of 75,200 dead in first 15 months, adding 3-4% of Gaza's population was wiped off by January 5, 2025.

item.title: Trump and Rubio suggest leveraging Board of Peace to mediate international conflicts
item.description: US President Trump and top diplomat Rubio signal the board's scope extends beyond the Palestinian territory, and could "serve as a model for other complex and difficult situations."

item.title: Iran tells UN chief it will respond 'decisively' to US attack after Trump issues new ultimatum
item.description: Iran tells Antonio Guterres that US President Trump's rhetoric "signals a real risk of military aggression", adding Tehran does not want war.

item.title: Rubio discusses development of Pakistan's critical minerals with Sharif
item.description: High-level talks between US and Pakistan take place on sidelines of inaugural Board of Peace meeting in Washington DC.

item.title: Trump orders agencies to identify and release government files on 'aliens'
item.description: Trump cites "tremendous interest" in the subject and accuses his predecessor Barack Obama of disclosing classified information during his recent remarks.

item.title: Pilot killed as Iran fighter jet crashes in Hamadan province
item.description: Tehran launches probe after Air force plane crashes during late-night training, state media say.

item.title: Petro rallies thousands as Colombia’s wage battle spills into streets
item.description: The president defies the court's suspension of sweeping pay rise, turning a legal dispute into a test of political strength and economic direction.

item.title: Argentina approves Milei's radical labour reform amid nationwide strike, clashes
item.description: The controversial labour reforms will make it easier for employers to hire and fire workers, while reducing severance pay, limiting strike rights and increasing working hours.
